mapper.select: SELECT I.id, I.member_id, I.job_id, J.company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.salary_amount, J.salary_type, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.accessibility_verified, J.source, J.contact_number, J.entry_type, J.managing_agency, J.recruitment_start_date, J.deadline, J.status, I.created_at, J.updated_at FROM interest_job I JOIN job_posting J ON J.id = I.job_id WHERE I.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY I.created_at DESC, I.id DESC
